explanation:
### How it works

Because the list is sorted, every repeated value forms one consecutive run. Keep a pointer to the last accepted node and move the scanning pointer to the end of a run. Keep a run only when it contained one node.

### Steps

1. Place a dummy before the head.
2. Scan to the last node of each equal-value run.
3. Advance the accepted pointer for a singleton, or bypass the entire repeated run.

### Complexity

- Time: O(n).
- Space: O(1).

### Things to watch for

- Remove every copy of a repeated value, including the first.
- The dummy handles a repeated run at the head.
- An entirely duplicated list returns an empty list.
